testsuite.name: Aland - Registration, Login & Admin Approval (Iteration 2)
testsuite.details:
Tester: Aland (GitHub Aland95)
Software under test: UniShare main, authentication implementation b124314.
Test basis: assignment/UniShare Iteration 2.md detailed Use Cases 1-3: UC-S2-001 Student Registration, UC-S2-002 Admin Approval, UC-S2-003 Student Login; src/server/api/routers/user.ts, admin.ts, src/server/auth/config.ts, middleware.ts, src/app/(auth) and src/app/(admin), src/app/(student)/layout.tsx, src/app/api/uploadthing/core.ts, src/lib/email.ts, prisma/schema.prisma.
Techniques: Equivalence Partitioning (EP), Boundary Value Analysis (BVA), Decision Table, State Transition, Use Case, Error Guessing.

Common test data: From prisma/seed.ts: Admin User, admin@unishare.com (ADMIN); Sarah Ahmed, sarah@student.utm.my (APPROVED); John Doe, john@student.utm.my (APPROVED); Alice Wong, alice@student.utm.my (PENDING); Michael Chen, michael@student.utm.my (APPROVED, Faculty of Engineering). All seeded passwords are admin123. Admin, Sarah, John and Alice use Universiti Teknologi Malaysia / Faculty of Computing. Seed passwords predate the new-registration uppercase rule; login does not apply registration password complexity.

Execution setup: UniShare runs on http://localhost:3000 with a disposable seeded Postgres database, configured UploadThing and a controlled SMTP capture/stub. Restore the initial fixture before each independent case; never reseed the group's TestLink database. The new-applicant baseline is name 'Aland QA', unused email aland.qa.01@example.com, password and confirmation 'Test1234', seeded UTM and Computing IDs obtained from user.getUniversities, and a successfully uploaded student-id.jpg image of 1 MiB. API baseline studentIdUrl is https://utfs.io/f/aland-qa-id.jpg; it is a validation fixture, not a promised live image. Use a fresh aland.qa.N@example.com email for every accepted registration within a case. API steps use a local tRPC client/server caller with the indicated session and exact JSON input; inspect responses in developer tools. Database checks use Prisma Studio or a local query. File sizes are exact bytes; 1 MiB = 1048576 bytes.

Oracle policy: Current code supplies URLs, limits and exact application messages. Requirements explicitly labelled document-only retain the iteration's business expectation and identify the missing check; do not mark them passed from code inspection. Browser-native validation and UploadThing errors vary by version; assert validity/error state and the application's literal 'Upload failed: ' prefix, rather than inventing library text. Numbered steps are generated by load.py. All cases remain Not Run for Project 1.
